dog.description_text:
Pozole is a 10-month-old mixed breed weighing around 26 pounds, and he's a sweet pup with lots of personality! He can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once he gets comfortable, he forms strong bonds with his humans and shows just how affectionate he can be. His love language is definitely physical touch, and he's a big fan of cuddles and belly rubs!

Pozole is also house-trained, enjoys meeting dogs of all shapes and sizes, and is a good walking buddy. He's looking for a patient adopter who can give him time to settle in, help him continue building confidence, and shower him with all the affection he loves!

Registered adopters interested in Pozole can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
